profile.summary:
Currently pursuing Masters in Computer Science from the University of Colorado Boulder.

Experienced Software Engineer with a demonstrated history of working in the health care industry. (Software Engineer at Philips for 1 year)

Skillsets
Programming languages: C++, Java, Python
Frameworks: Spring, SpringBoot, React, Flask, OpenCV
Tools: Eclipse, Docker, Kubernetes, Git, Qt
Cloud Platforms: AWS, GCP
Databases: MySQL, MongoDB, Cassandra

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Working with the core Search Team at Splunk, contributing towards the improvement of large-scale data processing and searching.

• Contributed towards the development of the memory and disk-storage efficient version of a stats command. Stats command provides statistical operations on the large datasets and is 3rd most used command in Splunk.
• Fixed various crashes and bugs in the serialization and deserialization for the stats command.
• Added the functionality of allowing the stats command to differentiate between cached data
and non-cached data at granular level, allowing customers to push summarized and normal data
in the same index (file).
• Re-designed the sharing pool of large strings for memory conservation, improving the memory usage by 12 percent for long searches (5+ mins).
• Contributing towards the implementation of AST optimization for Splunk’s sub searches (query inside a query), enabling search runtime with potential benefit of 12 % runtime improvement for long searches (5+ mins).
• Collaborated with SRE team to refine the search level Indicator (success Metrics) by setting up the new
detectors and correlation logic, thereby reducing the false alarms by 90%.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Worked as Full Stack Software engineer with Citrix Endpoint Management Team, with the responsibility for designing, implementing, and enhancing the existing remote management services.

• Improved the password setting capability, enabling the customers to use any character/s in their passwords.

• Worked with TechOps team to improve the security threat detection in code repositories using static code analyzer such as SonarQube.

• Updated the services to use the independent navbar, decreasing the dependency on a single service.

• Analyzed the XSS security threats and implemented the solution to mitigate them.

positions.title: Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
Primarily graded the assignments of students for the class "Programming workshop in C++' and giving feedback about their mistakes.

Contributed to automating the grading of assignments by writing unit tests and scripts in Python and C++.

Guided the students with their assignments and open source projects.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Used C++ to develop a real-time event logging tool, consisting of serializer and de-serializer for loading/logging the events from/to JSON format. This helped customers to check the health of magnet coils in MRI and perform analytics.
• Implemented algorithms in C++ for checking the health of RF signal receivers.
• Improved the coding standard and complexity of existing Codebase (1k files) with the help of TICS (Code Evaluating Tool) from 76 % to 84 %.
• Used C++ to create the service pack to edit certain parameters of configuration in the simulated system, increasing the automation workflow.
• Resolved various bugs/fixes during the testing phase of the software increasing maintainability and scalability.

positions.title: Intern
positions.description: • Used JavaScript d3 library and Graphviz for UI to develop a graph visualizer Tool for the hardware configuration file, which showed the various MRI hardware sockets and plugs connection.

projects.title: Depth Estimation using Deep Learning
projects.description: Researching on computing the depth map of a monocular image using low-cost LIDAR data and deep learning models and to improve the deep sensing camera’s accuracy using deep learning.

projects.title: NutrionoKid
projects.description:
We developed this app in 24 hours T9 Hackathon at CU Boulder.

Inspiration?
We were inspired by the Head Starter's vision to develop the products for the betterment for children, which are going to be our next generation. We couldn't find any app regarding the recipe's recommendation for children. Also, in developing countries, there are so many children that are having multiple deficiencies of various nutrients. We kept them in the mind and made this project.

What it does?
Our web app has 2 parts. Initially, the app will make a profile for the child containing the age of child, sex, weight, height, activity level of a child and allergic to any items. As per profile, our app will suggest the recipes suitable for the kids, targetting to cover all the nutritional values required for the children as per the data from the USDA nutrient calculator(approximately hardcoded).

Secondly, our app has also a feature to take input the recipes which parents are currently feeding to their children. As per the input of recipes and approximate quantity of them, we will recommend the other dishes if the nutritional requirements(calculated in part 1) of the child are not fulfilled.

How we built it?
We created front-end with ReactJs and JavaScript. We developed the back-end part using spring boot which will deal with services handling to show suggestions as per the profile entered through the form. The suggestion of recipes
